info.title: Rejection Rejector Local Integration API
info.description: Authenticated, loopback-only local API and embedded web interface. Browser Origin requests are refused except same-origin writes from the embedded page, responses are no-store, every response carries X-Request-ID, X-RR-API-Contract-SHA256 and a strict Content-Security-Policy, direct liveness distinguishes API-thread availability from state-worker responsiveness, worker operations expose a local correlation UUID, errors use stable machine-readable codes, privacy-safe operational metrics are available as both JSON and standards-compliant OpenMetrics 1.0 text, and the local listener enforces a bounded pre-authentication token bucket. Read endpoints stay read-only; the operator web UI issues state-changing commands through the bearer-protected /v1/commands/* channel, which enforces the same server-side gates as the desktop and terminal interfaces (shared send gate, confirm-exact-reply payload matching, cooldown-gated Automatic arming) under a fixed request-body cap.

bearerAuth.description: Random local token stored encrypted by Rejection Rejector.

RuntimeLogStatus.description: Privacy-minimal local runtime-journal storage health; contains no log records or private mailbox/profile fields.

operation_id.description: Locally generated UUID correlating one worker operation lifecycle across status and runtime journal records.

kind.description: Stable snake_case worker operation identifier. Clients must tolerate future additive values. Current values include profile_model and compact_database.

code.description: Stable operation failure code. retryable_* permits bounded retry; review_required_* requires operator/user action; reconcile_required_* means an external write may have crossed the boundary and must not be retried before reconciliation. Other codes are non-retryable unless retryable=true.

retryable.description: True only when retrying this operation after bounded backoff is safe. External-write ambiguity is false and uses a reconcile_required_* code.

operational.description: Privacy-safe derived operational state including sync freshness, queue depth, backup freshness/failure-domain isolation and stable degradation reason codes.

stall_budget_seconds.description: Operation-specific monitoring threshold. This is not a forced-cancellation deadline.

StorageHealth.description: Privacy-safe workspace filesystem headroom. Thresholds are conservative engineering guardrails, not availability SLOs.

distinct_failure_domain.description: True when scheduled backups are measured on a distinct filesystem/volume, false when they share the live-state failure domain, null when unavailable/not configured.

reason.description: Privacy-safe emergency-stop state. The configured filesystem path is never returned.

automatic_arm_cooldown_seconds.description: Cooldown the Automatic-arm risk confirmation must wait out, enforced server-side.

confirm_reply.description: The exact reply text shown in the confirm-exact-reply dialog. It must match the persisted draft byte for byte or the send is refused with confirm_reply_mismatch.

UpdateSettingsRequest.description: Partial edit; omitted fields keep their current value. Automatic mode additionally requires sending enabled and an acknowledged arm confirmation (automatic_not_armed otherwise).

action.description: open starts the cooldown, confirm is refused while it runs (automatic_arm_cooldown), cancel abandons the arming.

remaining_seconds.description: Seconds left on the server-side cooldown countdown.

RequestId.description: Per-request correlation identifier generated locally by Rejection Rejector.

ContractFingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the exact OpenAPI document bytes served by /v1/openapi.json. Semantic compatibility remains governed by api_version/v1.

BuildIdentityFingerprint.description: SHA-256 identity of deterministic build inputs embedded in the running binary.

ContentSecurityPolicy.description: Strict Content-Security-Policy set on every response: the embedded page may run only its own inline style/script and same-origin API calls; email content is rendered as plain text and never as markup.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication, Host or Origin policy rejected the request

WorkerUnavailable.description: Worker queue busy or local worker timeout

RateLimited.description: Local loopback request burst exceeded the fixed token-bucket guard.

WriteConflict.description: A server-side gate refused the write: stale_revision, confirm_reply_mismatch, send_gate_blocked, automatic_arm_cooldown, automatic_arm_not_open, automatic_not_armed, wrong_mode or demo_blocked. The stable code names the gate.

RequestTooLarge.description: The request body exceeded the fixed local write cap and was refused before parsing (request_body_too_large).

200.description: API thread is alive; body separately reports whether the state-owning worker is within its operation-specific progress budget.
Readiness state including database integrity, enterprise policy, typed worker operation state and privacy-minimal runtime-journal storage health.
Current verified tamper-evident audit anchor. Existing top-level head remains for v1 compatibility; sequence/workspace fields and the versioned nested anchor are additive.

get.summary: Check whether an audit anchor is known

get.description: Aggregate local operational metrics only. No mailbox address, message content, recipients, OAuth credentials, API token, signature, or candidate facts are included.

Cursor-based traversal over a fixed SQLite row high-water mark. New messages arriving after the first page do not shift or appear inside the in-progress traversal. Cursor values are opaque URL-safe tokens.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by the previous page.

get.summary: Explain whether a stored rejection is eligible for unattended dispatch

get.description: Authenticated loopback-only OpenMetrics snapshot. Contains no account, employer, candidate, recipient, message-body or credential labels. Defaults to stable OpenMetrics 1.0 text while OpenMetrics 2.0 remains experimental.

Single-page UI embedded in the binary (no Node, no external assets). The shell contains no data and is served without a bearer token; every data route stays authenticated. Email content is rendered as plain text only, and every response carries a strict Content-Security-Policy.

get.summary: Non-secret presentation settings for the web interface
get.description: Mode, tone (including the Insane level), reply-language policy, sending toggle and Automatic-arm state only; no credentials, paths or mailbox identity are exposed.

post.summary: Persist an edited reply draft (mirrors Command::Edit)
post.description: Writes the operator-edited reply for one reviewable job. Human review mode only; the (id, revision) binding must be current or the write is refused with stale_revision.

200.description: Command accepted and executed; the typed operation status is included

post.summary: Discard the draft and request a fresh local analysis (mirrors Command::Regenerate)
post.description: Human review mode only; demonstration mode never runs a local model (demo_blocked).

200.description: Command accepted and executed; the typed operation status is included

post.summary: Dismiss one reviewable job without sending (mirrors Command::Dismiss)
post.description: Stale revisions are refused with stale_revision.

200.description: Command accepted and executed; the typed operation status is included

post.summary: Send the exact persisted draft after confirm-exact-reply (mirrors Command::Send)
post.description: Server-side gates run before dispatch and again inside the engine: the shared send_gate_eligible gate, the confirm-exact-reply payload matching the persisted draft byte for byte (confirm_reply_mismatch otherwise), and the editor (id, revision) binding (stale_revision otherwise). Automatic-mode arming is guarded by the config::AutomaticArmGate cooldown of 30 seconds, enforced server-side rather than in the page.

200.description: Command accepted and executed; the typed operation status is included

post.description: Partial settings edit. Saving Automatic mode requires sending enabled and an acknowledged arm confirmation (automatic_not_armed); the reserved api_allow_writes setting still rejects true.

200.description: Command accepted and executed; the typed operation status is included

post.summary: Drive the cooldown-gated Automatic-mode arming flow
post.description: open starts the config::AutomaticArmGate 30-second cooldown and returns the visible countdown; confirm is refused while the cooldown runs (automatic_arm_cooldown) and only then flips the workspace to Automatic mode; cancel abandons the arming and stays in Human review.

200.description: Command accepted and executed; the typed operation status is included
